answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Jade carver faceted gem mark witnessed by the stone board flips the bet — each faceted gem is a wax seal pressed beside the cutters mark, so a farm must carve a hundred real jades by hand — and the nadir lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the atlas of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The dune is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
